claim: NVIDIA will retain >=75% revenue share of data-center AI accelerators through end-2027

positions.stance: Yes, on a merchant-silicon denominator NVIDIA stays at 80%+ via Rubin cadence and CUDA lock-in
sources: NVIDIA GTC 2026 Keynote (Jensen Huang) — Rubin Platform
SemiAnalysis: Accelerator Market Share and the ASIC Inflection

positions.stance: No, on an all-accelerator denominator including captive ASICs, NVIDIA falls to ~68% by 2027
sources: Morgan Stanley Research: AI Accelerator TAM and NVIDIA Share Trajectory

why_they_differ: The answer flips entirely on whether captive hyperscaler ASIC volumes are counted in the denominator at internal transfer value; merchant-only views keep NVIDIA above 75% while all-silicon views push it below.

claim: Hyperscaler custom ASICs are primarily eroding NVIDIA share in inference, not training

positions.stance: ASIC erosion concentrated in inference where cost-per-token dominates
sources: Morgan Stanley Research: Custom Silicon vs Merchant GPU Economics
Reuters: NVIDIA's data-center dominance tested as custom AI chips gain ground

positions.stance: Training is also shifting as Trainium3 and TPU v7 reach frontier-cluster scale (Project Rainier, Anthropic TPU)
sources: Bloomberg: AWS scales Trainium3 to cut reliance on NVIDIA GPUs
Financial Times: Anthropic commits to up to 1 million Google TPUs

why_they_differ: Analysts agree inference erodes first, but disagree on whether 2026-2027 training migration is material; bulls on ASICs cite frontier-lab multi-silicon deals while skeptics note NVLink-scale training still favors GPUs.

positions.stance: ~$420B including captive ASICs at merchant-equivalent value
sources: Morgan Stanley Research: AI Accelerator TAM and NVIDIA Share Trajectory
TrendForce: AI Server and Accelerator Shipment Outlook 2026-2027

positions.stance: Merchant-only TAM materially smaller; captive valuation is an analyst construct, not booked revenue
sources: SemiAnalysis: Accelerator Market Share and the ASIC Inflection

why_they_differ: TAM size depends on whether internally-consumed ASICs are imputed a market value; there is no audited revenue for captive silicon, so estimates diverge by methodology.

claim: HBM supply is the binding constraint on accelerator output through 2027

positions.stance: HBM sold out through 2026 and gating; HBM4 qualification timing sets ceiling
sources: Reuters: SK Hynix says HBM sold out through 2026 amid AI memory boom
Micron Technology FQ3 2026 Earnings Call

positions.stance: CoWoS advanced packaging is the tighter bottleneck; HBM can be added faster than CoWoS
sources: Nikkei Asia: TSMC races to expand CoWoS as AI packaging bottleneck persists
SemiAnalysis: CoWoS and HBM Supply Model 2026-2027

why_they_differ: Memory makers emphasize HBM scarcity while packaging analysts argue CoWoS expansion lead-times are longer; both are constraints but which binds first varies by quarter and vendor allocation.

claim: Broadcom has a fourth major custom-XPU customer that is OpenAI

positions.stance: Reports and guidance point to OpenAI as the fourth XPU customer co-designed on TSMC
sources: Bloomberg: Broadcom AI revenue surges on hyperscaler XPU demand
SemiAnalysis: Accelerator Market Share and the ASIC Inflection

positions.stance: Broadcom names a prospect but does not officially confirm identity; could be another lab
sources: Broadcom Inc. Q2 FY2026 Earnings Call Transcript

positions.stance: Reuters/Bloomberg reporting widely reads it as OpenAI based on supply-chain checks
sources: Reuters: NVIDIA's data-center dominance tested as custom AI chips gain ground

why_they_differ: Broadcom declines to officially name customers for confidentiality; the OpenAI attribution rests on press supply-chain checks rather than company confirmation.

claim: AMD will reach double-digit (>=10%) merchant accelerator share by 2027

positions.stance: Yes, ~11% on MI350/MI400 ramp and ROCm maturity
sources: Morgan Stanley Research: Custom Silicon vs Merchant GPU Economics
AMD Advancing AI 2025 Event — MI350/MI400 Helios Roadmap

positions.stance: Skeptical; ROCm catch-up and second-in-line CoWoS/HBM allocation cap gains below 10%
sources: SemiAnalysis: Accelerator Market Share and the ASIC Inflection

why_they_differ: Bulls weight AMD's roadmap and design wins; skeptics weight software-ecosystem inertia and supply-allocation disadvantage behind NVIDIA.

claim: US export controls have materially curbed NVIDIA's China accelerator revenue

positions.stance: Yes, H20/B-series licensing removed ~$12B annualized China revenue
sources: BIS Interim Final Rule: Additional Export Controls on Advanced Computing Items
Reuters: BIS revises H20 licensing as US-China chip tensions persist

positions.stance: Confirmed by NVIDIA's own disclosures of China write-downs and reduced China DC mix
sources: NVIDIA Corporation Form 10-K Fiscal Year 2026

why_they_differ: Regulator filings and NVIDIA's own 10-K corroborate the revenue impact; the magnitude estimate carries modest uncertainty but direction is uncontested.

claim: Anthropic has committed to up to ~1 million Google TPUs

positions.stance: Yes, multi-gigawatt TPU commitment reported for Claude training/inference
sources: Financial Times: Anthropic commits to up to 1 million Google TPUs

positions.stance: Figure is a reported capacity ceiling, not a confirmed contractual unit count
sources: SemiAnalysis: ClusterMax — Trainium and TPU Deployment Census

why_they_differ: The ~1M figure traces to a single FT report and supply-chain interpretation; neither Google nor Anthropic published an audited unit number, so it remains single-origin pending corroboration.

claim: Huawei Ascend can meaningfully substitute for NVIDIA in China at scale by 2027

positions.stance: Ascend 910C scaling on SMIC fills China demand as NVIDIA is restricted
sources: Nikkei Asia: Huawei scales Ascend 910C on SMIC amid HBM scarcity

positions.stance: Output capped near ~700k/yr by SMIC 7nm yield and stockpiled HBM; far below China demand
sources: SemiAnalysis: Accelerator Market Share and the ASIC Inflection

why_they_differ: Both agree Ascend is China's primary substitute, but disagree on whether constrained SMIC capacity and HBM scarcity allow true at-scale substitution versus a partial stopgap.
